newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA LISTED CARBID 1996 PROFIT UP.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA LISTED CARBID 1996 PROFIT UP.

text.p: Romania's Carbid-Fox SA, a carbide maker listed on the Bucharest bourse, reported on Thursday a 1996 net profit of 6.8 billion lei, some 2.0 billion up on the previous year.
Last year's net profit was around 571 million lei higher than forecast, showed a company report sent to the Bucharest bourse after a recent meeting of Carbid shareholders.
Carbid will pay a net dividend per share of 153.31 lei, compared to around 141 lei in 1995, the report showed.
The company was suspended from bourse trading since Tuesday pending the announcement and its publication in two leading newspapers. It is expected to resume trading next week.
The report said Carbid planned a 1997 net profit of some 9.3 billion lei, with 4.0 billion going to shareholders as dividends.

Carbid, based in the Transylvanian town of Tirnaveni, has a share capital of more than 23 billion lei, with the employees having a 70.27 percent stake. The State Ownership Fund has 19 percent, an investment company holds 1.19 percent and individual shareholders have the rest. ($=6,992 lei)
